title: Technique KB — shared definitions
description: Enumerations and reusable structures shared by all record types. Schema layer strings are English; authored content is Chinese (field names ending in _zh).

id.description: Stable, human-readable, low-case identifier. Dots separate namespaces, e.g. schiele, schiele.1911-1914, work.schiele.1912.laternenbluete-selbstbildnis.

sourceGrade.description: A = scholarly (catalogue raisonne, monograph, peer-reviewed article, museum research document). B = institutional (museum object page, official collection database, archive record). C = secondary (exhibition microsite, press article, interview, documentary).

dimension.description: The six dimensions every period dossier must cover. See docs/schema.zh.md.

compositionField.description: structure_proportion = 结构与比例; color = 颜色; framing = 取景; light_shadow = 明暗光影; brushwork = 画面技法与笔法.

axis.description: Comparison axes include the five composition fields plus material, subject matter and lineage.

source.description: Must resolve to an entry in data/registry/sources.yaml.

locator.description: Where in the source: page, plate, catalogue number, chapter, section heading. Never leave this vague enough to be uncheckable.

quote.description: Verbatim supporting passage. If the source text is not quoted, write what is shown (e.g. a plate caption) rather than a paraphrase.

translation_zh.description: Chinese rendering of the quote when quote_lang is not zh.

canvas.description: Canvas id inside the work's IIIF manifest; omit when the manifest has a single canvas.

region.description: IIIF region: 'full', 'pct:x,y,w,h' or 'x,y,w,h' in image pixels. This is how a claim points at the exact stroke it is talking about.

note_zh.description: What to look at in this region.

claim.description: The atomic unit of the knowledge base: one falsifiable sentence plus its evidence. Questions are answered by retrieving claims, never by free generation.

statement_zh.description: One sentence, falsifiable, no hedging filler. If it needs two sentences it is two claims.

iiif_evidence.description: Optional visual proof: the region of a work that shows the claim.

note_zh.description: Disagreements, limits of the claim, or what it does not cover.
